name: google-health-daily
description:
Last night's sleep, yesterday's step count and the resting heart rate from the Google Health API (Pixel Watch and Fitbit devices). Read-only: three GET requests, nothing is written. Returns `sleep` (start and end in local time, minutes asleep and awake, minutes per stage, whether it ended this morning), `resting_heart_rate` (latest value and the mean over the last 7 days), `steps` (yesterday's total) and `nothing_recorded` (true only when the API answered ALL THREE readings and every answer was empty, i.e. the device was not worn or has not synced; false whenever a reading is under `unavailable`, since what was recorded is then not known). A reading that could not be read is listed under `unavailable` with its HTTP status and the others are still returned; a reading with no data is `null`. Canonical building block for a morning message.

Requires a vault:// reference to a Google OAuth access token in the AUTH_HEADER config key. The controller resolves + refreshes the token at dispatch time.

AUTH_HEADER.description: vault:// path to the OAuth access token wrapped in 'Bearer ' (e.g. 'Bearer vault://oauth/google_health/{user_id}/{account}/access_token'). The controller resolves + refreshes the token if expired.

TIME_ZONE.description: IANA zone name (e.g. 'America/New_York') whose local date decides what 'today', 'yesterday' and 'last night' are. The zone's own daylight-saving rules apply. An unknown zone is an error.

DATA_SOURCE.description: Which sources to read: 'all-sources' (the API's default when omitted), 'google-wearables' (watch and tracker only), 'google-sources' or 'self-sources'.

setup_instructions.title: Enable the Google Health API
setup_instructions.detail: In https://console.cloud.google.com, enable the Google Health API (health.googleapis.com) for the project your Talos Google OAuth client belongs to, and add these scopes to the OAuth consent screen: 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/googlehealth.sleep.readonly', 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/googlehealth.activity_and_fitness.readonly', 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/googlehealth.health_metrics_and_measurements.readonly'.

setup_instructions.title: Authorize the integration
setup_instructions.detail: Connect Google Health from the Talos integrations page. The controller stores tokens at 'oauth/google_health/{user_id}/{account}/{access|refresh}_token' and tracks expiry.

setup_instructions.title: Configure AUTH_HEADER
setup_instructions.detail: Set AUTH_HEADER to 'Bearer vault://oauth/google_health/{your_user_id}/{your_account}/access_token' and TIME_ZONE to your zone. For 401s, use refresh_oauth_token(vault_path) to force a refresh and inspect the outcome.
